premapped.title: PreMapped - Worldgen Foundation
premapped.setup.playerless: Uses your world settings without joining as a player.
premapped.monitor.note: Closing saves and stops this session. Resume is manual. Only chunks verified as FULL in vanilla storage count as completed.
premapped.changed.title: Worldgen inputs have changed
premapped.changed.message: Mods, datapacks, dimension settings or configuration differ from the saved job. Continuing may create terrain seams. Approve this change and resume?
premapped.cancel.title: Remove this generation job?
premapped.cancel.message: Already generated world chunks will be kept. The current chunk may finish before the job is removed.
